policy: Faithful capture of what the learner studied: official lesson glossaries, useful words and phrases from the official scripts and exercises, and items from the learner's notes. Official spelling is canonical; the learner's spelling is kept as learnerForm. Nothing captured is removed. pendingEntries wait for the learner's yes/no and are never built; declinedEntries record a learner's no.
